recognize_zh: 周邊血中有大量中型母細胞，染色質細緻、細胞質灰藍色且邊緣有偽足狀突起或「尾巴」，核有時呈凹陷不規則；TCL1 免疫染色強陽性、流式呈 CD4+/CD123 高表現，符合母細胞性漿細胞樣樹突細胞腫瘤 (BPDCN) 的白血病型。
features: Panel A: numerous medium-sized blasts replacing normal leukocytes, with occasional residual neutrophils
Panels B-D, F-H: blasts with fine immature chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and indented, folded or irregular nuclear contours
Moderate grey-blue agranular cytoplasm with pseudopod-like projections, cytoplasmic blebs and tail-like extensions
Panel E: strong nuclear/cytoplasmic TCL1 positivity in most cells
Panel I: flow cytometry showing a dominant CD4+ / CD123 bright population (88.7%)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous medium-sized blasts with fine chromatin, irregular folded nuclei and moderate agranular grey-blue cytoplasm bearing pseudopodia and cytoplasmic tails. Immunohistochemistry demonstrates strong TCL1 expression, and flow cytometry identifies a CD4-positive, bright CD123 population comprising 88.7% of analyzed events. Findings are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm presenting as an acute leukemic variant in a child.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monoblasts/promonocytes are MPO/NSE and CD14/CD11b/lysozyme positive, whereas BPDCN is MPO negative and co-expresses CD4, CD56, CD123, TCL1 and TCF4.
ALL blasts express TdT with CD19/CD22 or cytoplasmic CD3 and lack the CD4/CD123/TCL1 plasmacytoid dendritic phenotype.

ddx.dx: Mature plasmacytoid dendritic cell proliferation with myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: Mature pDCs in CMML-associated proliferations are CD56 negative, CD34 variable and accompanied by a myeloid neoplasm rather than a blastic leukemic population.
